1	from django.conf import settings
2	from rest_framework import viewsets, permissions, status
3	from rest_framework.decorators import action
4	from rest_framework.response import Response
5	from django.db.models import Q
6	from app.documents.models import DocumentRequest, Evidence, Folder
7	from .serializers import DocumentRequestSerializer, EvidenceSerializer, PresignedUrlSerializer, FolderSerializer
8	from app.common.services.storage_service import StorageService
9	from app.tenants.permissions import has_client_view_all, scope_by_client

12	class DocumentRequestViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
13	    serializer_class = DocumentRequestSerializer
14	    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
15	
16	    def get_queryset(self):
17	        # Prefetch items + their uploaded evidence so the nested item `files` field isn't a
18	        # query per item (introduced with #315; fixed in the #316 sweep).
19	        queryset = DocumentRequest.objects.select_related(
20	            'process_step', 'created_by',
21	        ).prefetch_related('items', 'items__evidence_set')
22	        client_id = self.request.query_params.get('client')
23	        if client_id:
24	            queryset = queryset.filter(client_id=client_id)
25	        process_run = self.request.query_params.get('process_run')
26	        if process_run:
27	            queryset = queryset.filter(process_run_id=process_run)
28	        process_step = self.request.query_params.get('process_step')
29	        if process_step:
30	            queryset = queryset.filter(process_step_id=process_step)
31	        return scope_by_client(queryset, self.request.user, 'client')
32	
33	    def perform_create(self, serializer):
34	        serializer.save(created_by=self.request.user)
35	
36	    @action(detail=True, methods=['post'], url_path='portal-link')
37	    def portal_link(self, request, pk=None):
38	        """Mint (or reuse) a client-portal access token for this request and return the
39	        shareable link (#312). Firm-authenticated; the client uses the link with no login.
40	        Reuses a still-live token so re-sharing doesn't churn tokens."""
41	        from app.documents.models import DocumentRequestAccessToken
42	
43	        doc_request = self.get_object()
44	        # issue() revokes any prior live token and mints a fresh one (single active link).
45	        token, raw = DocumentRequestAccessToken.issue(doc_request, created_by=request.user)
46	        return Response(
47	            {'token': raw, 'path': f'/portal/{raw}', 'expires_at': token.expires_at},
48	            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
49	        )
50	
51	    @action(detail=True, methods=['post'], url_path='revoke-portal-link')
52	    def revoke_portal_link(self, request, pk=None):
53	        """Revoke every live client-portal token for this request (#315) — kills any
54	        shared link so the client can no longer open the portal."""
55	        from django.utils import timezone
56	        doc_request = self.get_object()
57	        now = timezone.now()
58	        revoked = 0
59	        for tok in doc_request.access_tokens.filter(revoked_at__isnull=True, expires_at__gt=now):
60	            tok.revoked_at = now
61	            tok.save(update_fields=['revoked_at'])
62	            revoked += 1
63	        return Response({'revoked': revoked}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

65	class FolderViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):

69	    def get_queryset(self):

71	        client_id = self.request.query_params.get('client')

82	            queryset = queryset.filter(task_id=task)
83	        if not has_client_view_all(self.request.user):
84	            queryset = queryset.filter(
85	                Q(client__assigned_team=self.request.user)
86	                | Q(process_run__client__assigned_team=self.request.user)
87	                | Q(task__account__assigned_team=self.request.user)

94	class EvidenceViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
95	    serializer_class = EvidenceSerializer
96	    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
97	
98	    def get_queryset(self):
99	        queryset = Evidence.objects.all()
100	
101	        folder = self.request.query_params.get('folder')
102	        if folder:
103	            queryset = queryset.filter(folder_id=folder)
104	
105	        step = self.request.query_params.get('step')
106	        if step:
107	            queryset = queryset.filter(process_step_id=step)
108	
109	        run = self.request.query_params.get('run')
110	        if run:
111	            queryset = queryset.filter(process_run_id=run)
112	
113	        # Evidence has no direct client FK — scope via its folder or process run.
114	        client_id = self.request.query_params.get('client')
115	        if client_id:
116	            queryset = queryset.filter(
117	                Q(folder__client_id=client_id) | Q(process_run__client_id=client_id)
118	            )
119	
120	        if not has_client_view_all(self.request.user):
121	            queryset = queryset.filter(
122	                Q(process_run__client__assigned_team=self.request.user)
123	                | Q(process_step__process_run__client__assigned_team=self.request.user)
124	                | Q(folder__client__assigned_team=self.request.user)
125	                | Q(folder__task__account__assigned_team=self.request.user)
126	                | Q(document_request_item__document_request__client__assigned_team=self.request.user)
127	            ).distinct()
128	
129	        return queryset.distinct()
130	
131	    def perform_create(self, serializer):
132	        serializer.save(uploaded_by=self.request.user)
133	
134	    @action(detail=False, methods=['post'])
135	    def upload(self, request):
136	        """
137	        Server-side file upload for the folder document browser: the browser POSTs a
138	        multipart file (+ optional folder), Django streams it to S3/MinIO and records
139	        the Evidence row. Avoids a browser->storage CORS hop for the documents view.
140	        """
141	        upload = request.FILES.get('file')
142	        if not upload:
143	            return Response({'error': 'No file provided'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
144	
145	        max_bytes = getattr(settings, 'MAX_EVIDENCE_UPLOAD_BYTES', 52428800)
146	        if upload.size > max_bytes:
147	            return Response(
148	                {'error': f'File exceeds the {max_bytes} byte limit'},
149	                status=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
150	            )
151	
152	        from django.db import connection
153	        content_type = upload.content_type or 'application/octet-stream'
154	        file_key = f"evidence/{connection.tenant.id}/{uuid.uuid4()}/{upload.name}"
155	
156	        if not StorageService.upload_fileobj(upload.file, file_key, content_type):
157	            return Response(
158	                {'error': 'Could not store file'},
159	                status=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
160	            )
161	
162	        folder = request.data.get('folder') or None
163	        process_run = request.data.get('process_run') or None
164	        process_step = request.data.get('process_step') or None
165	        evidence = Evidence.objects.create(
166	            type='FILE',
167	            folder_id=folder,
168	            process_run_id=process_run,
169	            process_step_id=process_step,
170	            file_key=file_key,
171	            filename=upload.name,
172	            content_type=content_type,
173	            size=upload.size,
174	            uploaded_by=request.user,
175	        )
176	        return Response(
177	            self.get_serializer(evidence).data,
178	            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
179	        )
180	
181	    @action(detail=False, methods=['post'])
182	    def presigned_upload(self, request):
183	        """
184	        Generate a presigned upload URL for S3.
185	        """
186	        serializer = PresignedUrlSerializer(data=request.data)
187	        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
188	        
189	        # Security: Prefix key with tenant_id to enforce isolation
190	        raw_key = serializer.validated_data['key']
191	        from django.db import connection
192	        file_key = f"evidence/{connection.tenant.id}/{raw_key}"
193	        content_type = serializer.validated_data.get('content_type', 'application/octet-stream')
194	        
195	        data = StorageService.generate_presigned_upload(file_key, content_type)
196	        if not data:
197	             return Response({'error': 'Could not generate URL'}, status=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
198	             
199	        return Response(data)
200	
201	    @action(detail=True, methods=['get'])
202	    def presigned_download(self, request, pk=None):
203	        evidence = self.get_object()
204	        if not evidence.file_key:
205	            return Response({'error': 'No file key'}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
206	            
207	        url = StorageService.generate_presigned_download(evidence.file_key)
208	        if not url:
209	            return Response({'error': 'Could not generate URL'}, status=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
210	            
211	        return Response({'url': url})

from django.db import models
import uuid
from app.tenants.models import User
from app.clients.models import Client
from app.compliance.models import ProcessRun, ProcessStep, ProcessTemplate

class DocumentRequest(models.Model):
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    client = models.ForeignKey(Client, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    process_run = models.ForeignKey(ProcessRun, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True)
    # Optionally scope the request to a specific task/step within the engagement.
    process_step = models.ForeignKey(
        ProcessStep, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='document_requests',
    )

    title = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    message = models.TextField(blank=True)
    due_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    
    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        OPEN = 'OPEN', 'Open'
        PARTIAL = 'PARTIAL', 'Partially Received'
        COMPLETE = 'COMPLETE', 'Complete'
        CANCELLED = 'CANCELLED', 'Cancelled'

    STATUS_CHOICES = Status.choices  # backward-compat alias
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.OPEN)

    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, related_name='created_doc_requests')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.client.name} - {self.title}"

class DocumentRequestItem(models.Model):
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    document_request = models.ForeignKey(DocumentRequest, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='items')
    label = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    required = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    
    class Status(models.TextChoices):
        MISSING = 'MISSING', 'Missing'
        RECEIVED = 'RECEIVED', 'Received'
        WAIVED = 'WAIVED', 'Waived'

    STATUS_CHOICES = Status.choices  # backward-compat alias
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=Status.choices, default=Status.MISSING)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.label


class DocumentRequestAccessToken(models.Model):
    """A signed, expiring, single-request access token for the client upload portal (#312).

    Reuses the StaffInvitation pattern: the raw token is shown once (emailed in the portal
    link) and never stored — only its sha256 hash is persisted. Grants an unauthenticated
    client access to exactly ONE DocumentRequest (read its items + upload evidence)."""
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    document_request = models.ForeignKey(
        DocumentRequest, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='access_tokens',
    )
    token_hash = models.CharField(max_length=64, unique=True, db_index=True)
    expires_at = models.DateTimeField()
    revoked_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    @staticmethod
    def _hash(raw_token):
        import hashlib
        return hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode()).hexdigest()

    @classmethod
    def mint(cls, document_request, ttl_days=30, created_by=None):
        """Create a token for a request; returns ``(token, raw_token)``. The raw token is
        returned once (for the link) and is not recoverable from the DB."""
        import secrets
        from datetime import timedelta
        from django.utils import timezone

        raw_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        token = cls.objects.create(
            document_request=document_request,
            token_hash=cls._hash(raw_token),
            expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(days=ttl_days),
            created_by=created_by if getattr(created_by, 'is_authenticated', False) else None,
        )
        return token, raw_token

    @classmethod
    def issue(cls, document_request, created_by=None, ttl_days=30):
        """Mint a fresh token, revoking any existing live token for the request first.

        The raw token can't be recovered from the DB (only its hash is stored), so a
        caller that needs a usable link must mint anew; revoking the prior live token
        keeps a single active link per request. Returns ``(token, raw_token)``."""
        from django.utils import timezone
        now = timezone.now()
        for existing in document_request.access_tokens.filter(
            revoked_at__isnull=True, expires_at__gt=now,
        ):
            existing.revoked_at = now
            existing.save(update_fields=['revoked_at'])
        return cls.mint(document_request, ttl_days=ttl_days, created_by=created_by)

    @classmethod
    def resolve(cls, raw_token):
        """Return the live token for a raw token, or None if unknown/expired/revoked."""
        from django.utils import timezone
        if not raw_token:
            return None
        return (
            cls.objects.filter(
                token_hash=cls._hash(raw_token),
                revoked_at__isnull=True,
                expires_at__gt=timezone.now(),
            )
            .select_related('document_request', 'document_request__client')
            .first()
        )

    @property
    def is_live(self):
        from django.utils import timezone
        return self.revoked_at is None and self.expires_at > timezone.now()

    def __str__(self):
        return f"AccessToken for {self.document_request_id}"


class Folder(models.Model):
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    parent = models.ForeignKey('self', on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True, related_name='subfolders')
    client = models.ForeignKey(Client, on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True, related_name='folders')
    process_run = models.ForeignKey(ProcessRun, on_delete=models.CASCADE, null=True, blank=True, related_name='folders')
    task = models.ForeignKey('compliance.Task', on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='folders')

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

"""Tests for document-request create/update with items.

Regression: the API `items` field is read-only, so creating a request never
persisted its items and required a `title`. A write-only `items_needed` list now
creates/replaces DocumentRequestItem rows.
"""
from django.urls import reverse
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.test import APITestCase

from app.tenants.models import User
from app.clients.models import Client
from app.documents.models import DocumentRequest


class DocumentRequestItemsTests(APITestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = User.objects.create(email='admin@req.test', role='ADMIN')
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)
        self.account = Client.objects.create(name='Acme', client_type='COMPANY')

    def test_create_with_items_needed_persists_item_rows(self):
        resp = self.client.post(
            reverse('doc-requests-list'),
            {
                'client': str(self.account.id),
                'title': '2024 Year-end documents',
                'items_needed': ['Bank statements', 'Paid invoices'],
            },
            format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED, resp.data)
        # Items come back in the read-only nested `items`.
        labels = sorted(i['label'] for i in resp.data['items'])
        self.assertEqual(labels, ['Bank statements', 'Paid invoices'])
        req = DocumentRequest.objects.get(id=resp.data['id'])
        self.assertEqual(req.items.count(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(req.created_by, self.user)

    def test_create_requires_title(self):
        resp = self.client.post(
            reverse('doc-requests-list'),
            {'client': str(self.account.id), 'items_needed': ['X']},
            format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertIn('title', resp.data)

    def test_update_items_needed_replaces_rows(self):
        req = DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='Initial', created_by=self.user
        )
        req.items.create(label='Old item')
        resp = self.client.patch(
            reverse('doc-requests-detail', args=[req.id]),
            {'items_needed': ['New A', 'New B']},
            format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK, resp.data)
        labels = sorted(i['label'] for i in resp.data['items'])
        self.assertEqual(labels, ['New A', 'New B'])
        self.assertFalse(req.items.filter(label='Old item').exists())

    def test_mark_complete_accepts_backend_status(self):
        req = DocumentRequest.objects.create(
            client=self.account, title='T', created_by=self.user
        )
        resp = self.client.patch(
            reverse('doc-requests-detail', args=[req.id]),
            {'status': 'COMPLETE'},
            format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK, resp.data)
        self.assertEqual(resp.data['status'], 'COMPLETE')
